heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋小型圖片密集網格
desc: 上方置中的標題組，下方是置中、比頁面內容寬度窄的同尺寸小型圖片網格，每列項目多、無外框無格線，最後一格是按鈕或文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組。標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；標題與說明文字之間、標題組與下方網格之間留較大的空白。下方是多個項目排成的網格，整個網格置中，寬度約佔畫面寬的三分之二，明顯窄於頁面內容寬度；每列項目多、每個項目都很小，所有項目等寬、等高。每個項目無外框、沒有格線，只有一張小型圖片，在格內水平與垂直置中，所有圖片設定成同一尺寸，完整顯示、不裁切。網格最後一格不放圖片，改放一個按鈕或文字連結，在格內水平與垂直置中。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放；標題組仍置中，網格改為每列三個項目，橫跨頁面內容寬度；所有圖片仍為同一尺寸，網格最後一格仍是按鈕或文字連結。

en.name: Centered heading + dense grid of small images
en.desc: A centered heading group above a centered grid of same-size small images, narrower than the page content width, with many items per row and no frames or grid lines; the last cell is a button or text link.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Leave fairly large spaces between the title and the description and between the heading group and the grid below. Below is a grid of multiple items; the whole grid is centered and takes about two thirds of the viewport width, clearly narrower than the page content width; each row holds many items, each item is small, and all items are equal in width and height. Each item has no frame and there are no grid lines; it contains only a small image, centered horizontally and vertically within its cell; all images are set to the same size and shown in full without cropping. The last cell of the grid holds no image; instead it holds a button or a text link, centered horizontally and vertically within the cell.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally; the heading group stays centered, and the grid changes to three items per row, spanning the page content width; all images stay the same size, and the last cell of the grid is still a button or a text link.
